newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyocera buys out shareholders in troubled unit.
newsitem.headline: Kyocera buys out shareholders in troubled unit.

text.p: Kyocera Corp said on Wednesday that it has bought 990 million yen worth of shares in its troubled karaoke equipment unit this year, Kyocera Multimedia Corp, from non-group shareholders.
Following the move, Kyocera and its group companies now hold over 98 percent of the unit's shares, with Kyocera alone holding a 53.4 percent stake, up from an initial 25.0 percent.
A Kyocera official told Reuters that the company plans to buy all of the shares still owned by non-group companies.
Kyocera is involved in a variety of businesses including semiconductors and electronic parts.
